item.title: Dream Theater's MIKE PORTNOY Defends LARS ULRICH: 'He Takes a Beating, But He's Invaluable'
item.description: Mike Portnoy, drummer for Dream Theater, says Lars Ulrich deserves more credit. In a recent chat with El Estepario Siberiano (transcribed by LOUDLEGENDS.COM), Portnoy explained why he thinks the Metallica co-founder is often misunderstood.

item.title: MIKE PORTNOY Says LARS ULRICH Was a Major Influence: 'He Was More Than Just a Drummer'
item.description: Mike Portnoy, drummer for progressive metal band Dream Theater, recently shared that Lars Ulrich of Metallica had a big impact on his career, and not just behind the drum kit.
